intro: Sleek and purposeful, the Luna table redefines your corners. Its glossy marble finish, arc-shaped edges, and durable storage elevate your interiors with timeless beauty and function.

features.title: High-gloss finish adds a refined touch
features.text: Sleek, durable, and stunning—our marble-inspired surface transforms your space with a touch of modern elegance.

features.title: Edges that keep you and loved ones safe
features.text: Safety meets style! Gentle edges ensure safe handling, ideal for homes with kids or busy spaces.

features.title: Durable build for long-term use
features.text: Made to last—the sturdy material withstands daily use, offering both strength and lasting appeal.

features.title: Spacious shelf keeps things organised
features.text: Smart storage keeps your books, gadgets, and keepsakes organised without ever compromising the style of your space.

features.title: Wall-friendly for versatile placement
features.text: Wherever you need it—against a wall, tucked into a corner, or centre stage—our versatile design fits beautifully and enhances your space with ease.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
